text:
Lara: quick kickoff — we need a compact battlecard refresh for next week's launch + two webinar hooks. objective: help SDRs handle "we already use cloud X" and route high-value leads to Dedicated. keep messages short, sales-friendly.
Noah: agree. propose 3 core claims + 1-line rebuttals and one 2-line proof each. also two email subject lines (intent vs research).
Priya: for claims I'd lead with: 1) predictable unit economics, 2) production-grade latency & SLAs, 3) ops-first rollout tools.
Victor: rebut for cloud: "managed endpoints hide runtime variability" -> rebut line: "Reserve capacity, reduce billing volatility" -> proof: "Dedicated pools reduce p95 variance by ~3x in customer tests."
Jae: rebut for LLM APIs: "model access but no observability" -> rebut: "model catalog + perf telemetry" -> proof: "per-model p95 and cost cards available in the Console; attachable to evals."
Noah: rebut for infra vendors: "you get hardware, you build everything" -> rebut: "turnkey control plane for serving & rollouts" -> proof: "canary + auto-fallback templates shipped; typical integration < 2 weeks."
Lara: email subjects — A (high intent): "Try Dedicated: 2-week capacity trial + cost forecast" B (research): "How teams stabilize LLM costs and latency"
Priya: add a webinar hook: "See a live demo: routing, KV caching, and how we shave tokens without model changes" 30-min format: 15-min demo, 10-min case study, 5-min Q&A.
Victor: short SDR snippets (3 lines): 
- "Pin capacity to control spend — no more surprise token bills."
- "Get SLA-backed latency & routing fallbacks for production."
- "Turnkey rollouts: canaries, A/B, and auto-fallbacks out of the box."
Jae: quick tech soundbite for battlecard: "Prefix KV caching + adaptive batching reduce backend tokens and lower per-query GPU time."
Noah: add one sharp procurement line: Q: "Why not host it ourselves?" A: "We remove ops-heavy work: unified console, managed rollouts, and forecasting. Buying infra alone often costs months in engineering time."
Priya: routing rules to test: 
- webinar signups with tag:complpliance OR company_size>1000 -> route:sales-enterprise
- demo requests with account_tier==paid -> route:sales-dedicated
- all others -> route:marketing-nurture
Lara: SDR email templates: keep 2 variants (short & long). short variant example: "Subject: Try Dedicated — 2-week trial
Hi <name>, we can set up a 2-week Dedicated capacity trial and a cost forecast for your workload. Quick 15-min call? — Lara"
Victor: also include a quick objection micro-script for calls: "If they say 'we use cloud X', reply: 'Cloud X accelerates prototyping; when you scale, dedicated capacity and caching drive consistent unit costs. We help with both.'"
Jae: small code snippet for routing rules (for ops handoff):
```
if signup.tags.contains('compliance') || company.size > 1000:
  route = 'sales-enterprise'
elif request.type == 'demo' and account.tier == 'paid':
  route = 'sales-dedicated'
else:
  route = 'marketing-nurture'
```
Noah: slide soundbites (one-liners): 
- "Control spend with reserved inference capacity."
- "SLAs and routing keep latency predictable."
- "Ops-first rollouts: canaries and fallback by default."
Priya: webinar CTA copy: "Register to see how AcmeFin cut inference spend 3x while improving p95 latency" -> routing: tag as high interest.
Lara: OpsBot can you create a tracking card for the A/B subject test + one for routing experiments? link them to PRJ-6342.
OpsBot: Created tickets: https://rwd-internal/track/PRJ-6342 (A/B subjects), https://rwd-internal/track/PRJ-6343 (routing). :white_check_mark:
Jae: I'll upload a short p95 chart and token-econ table to PRJ-6342 by EOD tomorrow.
Victor: I'll build the SDR cheat-sheet with the 3 rebut lines + 2 email variants and drop it in the tracker by noon.
Lara: perfect. please keep copy punchy (<=2 sentences per snippet). reconvene tomorrow 9:30 to finalize. thanks all :sparkles:
